reviews.text: Korean sheet masks are one of my skincare weaknesses because they're so convenient and relaxing to use. I usually reach for one when my skin feels like it needs a little extra care or when I simply want to enjoy a relaxing skincare night. I love keeping different types at home so I can choose one depending on how my skin feels that day. They're also great to stock up on when there's a good promotion.
reviews.zh: 韓國面膜係我嘅護膚軟肋，因為用起嚟好方便，又好放鬆。我通常係皮膚感覺需要多啲護理嗰陣，或者我只係想享受一個放鬆嘅護膚夜嗰陣，就會攞一張嚟用。我好鍾意屋企放住唔同款式，咁樣就可以按照嗰日皮膚嘅感覺揀一款。有好嘅優惠嗰陣，囤貨都好好。

reviews.text: I think 300 is too strong for my skin.
reviews.zh: 我覺得 300 對我嘅皮膚嚟講太強咗。

reviews.text: I tried this 300 version after using the 100 before, and it’s definitely much stronger. Right after applying the first step, I could immediately feel the tiny needles on my skin. I waited a while before using the sheet mask to make sure my skin could tolerate it. The sensation is very unique and unlike anything I’ve tried before, but I was expecting it from other people’s reviews, so it wasn’t too surprising. I only left the mask on for 10 minutes since it was my first time, and the tingling settled after about 20 seconds. So far, my skin feels fine, and I’m looking forward to seeing the results with regular use.
reviews.zh: 我之前用過 100 之後先試呢款 300 版本，佢絕對強好多。塗完第一步之後，我即刻感覺到皮膚上嘅細小針。我等咗一陣先用面膜，確保我嘅皮膚受得住。呢種感覺好獨特，係我之前未試過嘅感覺，不過我之前睇過其他人嘅評論，所以都唔算太意外。我因為係第一次用，所以只敷咗 10 分鐘，而刺麻感大約喺 20 秒之後就平伏咗。到目前為止，我皮膚感覺冇問題，我好期待定期使用之後嘅效果。

reviews.text: It delivers every time and makes my face feel baby soft and glow like I have make up on. That said, I don’t necessarily love the sheet mask material and it can sometimes feel like a blob of gooey stuff on my face.
reviews.zh: 每次都有效，令我嘅面摸落好似嬰兒咁幼滑，又好似化咗妝咁有光澤。話雖如此，我唔係好鍾意面膜嘅物料，有時候佢會令我面上好似一團黏糊糊嘅嘢。

reviews.text: I’ve already gone through ten boxes of the VT Reedle Shot mask packs! It is a total two-in-one savior because it includes a soothing mask to calm your skin right after applying the tingling Reedle Shot essence. Using it just once or twice a week as a special treatment does wonders for pores and overall skin condition. Highly recommend!
reviews.zh: 我已經用完咗十盒 VT Reedle Shot 面膜裝！佢絕對係二合一嘅救星，因為佢包咗一張舒緩面膜，塗完帶刺麻感嘅 Reedle Shot 精華之後，即刻幫皮膚舒緩。每星期只係用一兩次，當作特別護理，對毛孔同整體皮膚狀況都非常有幫助。強烈推薦！

reviews.text: I’m really impressed with the Hugrab V2 Pro! It’s so easy to use and the design is super user-friendly. I noticed an immediate reduction in puffiness after just one use, and my skin feels tighter and more lifted. The included gel works perfectly with the device, no irritation at all. Highly recommend it for anyone looking for a home care device that actually delivers results!
reviews.zh: 我對 Hugrab V2 Pro 真係好欣賞！佢超級易用，設計都好人性化。我只係用咗一次，就即刻見到浮腫減少咗，皮膚感覺更加緊緻、更提拉咗。附送嘅啫喱同儀器配合得非常好，完全冇刺激。推薦畀所有想搵一部真係有效嘅家用儀器嘅人！

reviews.text: Very good mask! The sheet fits perfectly, doesn’t slip off, and contains a lot of essence. My skin felt deeply hydrated and refreshed after using it. The material is soft and comfortable, and there was enough serum left to apply on the neck and hands. Definitely would buy again!
reviews.zh: 非常好嘅面膜！面膜貼面貼得好啱，唔會滑落，精華液又多。用完之後，皮膚感覺深層補水同清爽。物料柔軟又舒服，仲剩返足夠嘅精華，可以搽喺頸同手上。一定會再買！

reviews.text: The VT Reedle Shot 2Step Mask Pack is an absolute powerhouse for smoother skin, offering a deeply hydrating, non-sticky emergency treatment that leaves the face feeling fully plumped and beautifully renewed.If you need a high-intensity treatment that refines skin texture without leaving a heavy, sticky residue, this two-step mask pack is incredible. The innovative first step introduces micro-needling technology that tingles as it opens up the skin pathways, allowing the second-step sheet mask to absorb very easily and deeply. The formula sinks in beautifully and feels incredibly "full" on the face, intensely nourishing the skin from within rather than just sitting on top. It is the perfect emergency lifesaver for rough skin days, early mornings, or right before major events when you need a fast, dramatic boost in radiance. Makeup glides on flawlessly afterward because the non-sticky finish ensures zero pilling. Because it gives off a tingling sensation, for those who might not be used
reviews.zh: VT Reedle Shot 2Step 面膜裝係令皮膚更順滑嘅絕對強者，提供深層補水、唔黏嘅緊急護理，令面部感覺飽滿、煥然一新。如果你需要一款高強度護理，可以細化皮膚質感，又唔會留低厚重黏膩嘅殘留物，呢款兩步驟面膜裝真係好勁。創新嘅第一步採用微針技術，搽上去會有刺麻感，同時幫皮膚打開通道，令第二步嘅面膜可以好容易、深入咁吸收。配方滲入得好漂亮，搽咗之後面部感覺非常「飽滿」，由內到外深層滋養皮膚，而唔係淨係停留喺表面。佢係皮膚粗糙嘅日子、一大清早，或者重大活動之前嘅完美緊急救星，當你需要快速、顯著嘅亮澤提升嗰陣就最啱。之後化妝都推得好順，因為唔黏嘅質地確保唔會起粒。因為佢會有刺麻感，所以對於嗰啲可能唔習慣嘅人……
